gloss: graduated, progressive (esp. of taxation, fees, or rates that increase by tier)

definitions.gloss: progressive / graduated (increase in steps, typically of taxation or fees)
definitions.explanation: A system in which a rate, charge, or punishment increases in stages or tiers as some underlying quantity (income, usage, severity) rises. Most commonly seen in compounds: {累進|るいしん}{課税|かぜい} (progressive taxation), {累進|るいしん}{税率|ぜいりつ} (progressive tax rate), {累進|るいしん}{制|せい} (graduated/progressive system). Bare {累進|るいしん} on its own is rare in conversation; it almost always appears in such compounds in tax, finance, legal, and policy writing.

examples.japanese: {累進|るいしん}⟦{課税|かぜい}→課税：00203_kazei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{累進|るいしん}⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Progressive tax rates are applied to income tax.

examples.english: Under a progressive system, the higher one's income, the higher the tax rate.

notes:
{累進|るいしん} expresses a graduated, step-by-step increase. It is used almost exclusively in fixed compounds, especially in tax and finance.

FORMS:
- {累|るい} ("to accumulate, to pile up") + {進|しん} ("to advance, progress") → {累進|るいしん}

COMPOUNDS:
- {累進|るいしん}⟦{課税|かぜい}→課税：00203_kazei⟧: progressive taxation
- {累進|るいしん}⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧: progressive tax rate
- {累進|るいしん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: progressive / graduated system
- {累進|るいしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: progressive (in nature) — used adjectivally

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Bare {累進|るいしん} as a standalone noun is uncommon; it nearly always combines with ⟦{課税|かぜい}→課税：00203_kazei⟧, ⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧, ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧, or ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧.
- Frequently contrasted with ⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧ ("proportional, flat") and {逆進|ぎゃくしん}/{逆累進|ぎゃくるいしん} ("regressive").

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {累進|るいしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: progressive (adjectival form, e.g., {累進|るいしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧ "a progressive tax system")
- ⟦{累計|るいけい}→累計：08327_ruikei⟧: cumulative total — a related word with {累|るい} but different meaning (the running total of accumulated amounts)
- ⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧: proportional / flat tax — the typical contrast in tax policy
- {逆進|ぎゃくしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: regressive (of taxation) — the opposite tendency
- ⟦{段階|だんかい}{的|てき}→段階的：06174_dankaiteki⟧: step-by-step — overlaps in spirit but is much more general

USAGE:
- Outside of tax and policy writing, you may also see {累進|るいしん} in the phrase {累進|るいしん}⟦{処遇|しょぐう}→処遇：21125_shoguu⟧, an old term in Japanese prison administration referring to a graded incarceration system in which inmates' privileges progress with good behavior. This usage is technical and rare in everyday text.
- Glasses with {累進|るいしん}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ refers to progressive (multifocal) lenses — a separate technical sense from optometry, where lens power increases gradually from top to bottom.
